title: 第35章 孔诗岚，你可别后悔
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 陛下，事情已经办妥。”马车驶去没多远，宁川出现在马车旁。“嗯，既然太子不想要他，那朕就把他给老四吧，把他和老四关在一起。”马车内，炎文帝嘴角笑容渐渐收敛。本来想要将唐逸留给太子用的，结果这蠢货不争气。竖子不足与谋？要是这小子都不足与谋，天底下谁还能与你共谋？“陛下，四皇子性格火爆，唐逸这胳膊腿……”陈貂寺低声提醒了一句，就唐逸现在的身体，他能经得住打？“就是要让他们打起来……不过，戏的确不能太刻意。”炎文帝沉吟一下，道：“关到老四隔壁吧！宁川，你想办法激怒老四，让老四找唐逸麻烦。”“男人嘛，增进感情最好的方式就是打一架！”“让他们尽快磨合下，户部的案子，朕要交给他们来办。”这就是锦衣卫对唐逸很不友好的原因。因为炎文帝已经和宁川说过了，过段时间要让唐逸进锦衣卫，赐百户。锦衣卫无数兄弟熬了好几年都没得到的位置，他这个没有半点功劳的家伙进来就是百户，而且还是实权百户，这谁受得了？“臣遵旨。”宁川拱手，转身离开。“哼，每年户部六七百万赋税，现在能拿出来的钱不足五十万两！”“朕倒是要看看，这些银两都去哪里了！”炎文帝脸色难看，他刚决定和北狄打一战！结果户部就暴雷，告诉他没钱。接着，就是柳公瑾挪用税款数十万两的事情曝光了。还真是巧合啊！“陈貂寺，派人去一趟梁家，把唐音接到贤妃那里。”炎文帝眸色渐冷：“这时候，朕绝对不允许再出现任何意外。”“唐逸最在意的就是唐音，唐音要出现意外，唐逸非得造反不可！”……北镇抚司，监牢。唐逸刚进监牢，一股腐朽掺杂的血腥的难闻气息便扑鼻而来。与此同时，歇斯底里的惨叫声，也从廊道中传来，宛若厉鬼哀嚎。宁川带着几个锦衣卫就跟在唐逸身后，他觉得像唐逸这种官宦子弟，见到这样的恶臭和惨叫，肯定会当场上吐下泻，吓得屁滚尿流。却没想到，唐逸竟然一脸平静。一脸平静就算了，他似乎还对监牢很好奇。一路下来都在打量着监牢的布局，时不时点评两句，说什么电视剧演得保守了。不是，电视剧特妈谁啊？敢在锦衣卫面前演？而且，遇到一些囚犯，这厮甚至还笑着和人家聊上两句。“草，你能给点面子吗？你就不能装得怕一点？你这样我很没面子。”宁川有些恼怒，忍不了了。妈的，这货不是文官家的儿子吗？文官家的儿子，能特妈有这胆气？都说北镇抚司是阎王殿，你好歹对阎王殿有点敬畏行吗？他们不知道的是，唐逸上过战场，在战场上闻到的气息和血腥场面，岂是这小小的锦衣卫监牢能比的？“这家伙竟然没受刑，他犯的什么罪？”唐逸在一间牢房前停下脚步，好奇地打量着里面的犯人。里面的男人四十岁左右，穿着锦缎华服，正安静正在牢房中，脸色虽然平静，但目光中却带着浓浓的高傲和鄙夷。那种目光，仿佛见他们仿佛见一坨狗屎！傲慢，不可一世。唐逸仔细由上到下自习打量过后，眼底闪过一丝锐意。“你是犯事进来坐牢的，你以为你是长官视察呢？”宁川抬脚在唐逸的屁股上就是一脚。但还是回答了唐逸的问题：“他是汇州来的商贩，路引有点问题，但问题不大，等他的保人给他做保，他就可以走了。”当然，前提是得交一大笔保释金，不然锦衣卫的牌面不要了？“他不能放，相反，你可以布置一下，将他的保人也一同抓进来。”宁川和一群锦衣卫齐齐看向唐逸，就连里面男人也抬头看了过来。唐逸双手抓着牢房的铁条，看着中年男人道：“你是北狄的坐探吧？瞧你这样子，是刚到京都就阴差阳错被锦衣卫抓了。”听到这话，中年男人瞳孔骤然一缩，但很快就恢复了平静。“你说什么？！”宁川却瞬间跳了起来，被唐逸的话震惊了。一群锦衣卫，也都目瞪口呆地看着唐逸。我们抓来审过了，也得到消息证实了，这家伙的确是汇州来的商人，怎么就成北狄的坐探了？你这看一眼，怎么就确定他是北狄的坐探了？“锦衣卫？呵呵，我对你们的义务能力表示堪忧。”唐逸摇了摇头，指着男人的一头长发道：“首先，就是这家伙的发髻，他被抓时虽然把头发打乱了，但蓬乱的长发带着卷曲，依旧能看到辫子的痕迹。”“男人梳数条甚至百十条辫子，这是典型的北狄人装扮。”“至于为什么连伪装都不用，那是因为人家根本瞧不上你们……看他的眼睛，狂傲，不屑，鄙夷，看你们的眼神是不是在看狗屎？”“一个商人，敢这么看你们？可能吗？”“而且，他太沉着，太淡定了！该是一个怎样的商人，才能进了天牢而面不改色？？？”“另外，注意看——罗圈腿，说明这家伙长时间骑马，腿已经变形了。”“要是这些猜测不够……那就脱一下他的衣服，这家伙是大炎人里的叛徒，众所周知，大炎人被北狄人当成奴隶，是分等级的。”“他的身上，应该有奴隶印记。”男人听着唐逸的话，一开始是不屑，随即渐渐震惊，最后看向唐逸的目光已经怨毒和惊恐起来。锦衣卫被他用银子耍得团团转，根本没有注意这些细节，没想到这少年竟然看穿了。男人二话没说，转身就往石墙撞了过去。他要自杀！然而，他刚转身，宁川手中的刀已经出了鞘。随手一扬，刀已经刺穿男人的大腿。与此同时，他身后的几个锦衣卫也迅速做出反应，一刀劈断锁链，迅速冲进牢房将男人按在地上。同时往他嘴里塞了布，免得他咬舌自尽。很快，一个锦衣卫回来禀报，看向唐逸的目光都变了。“老大，确定了，他屁股上确有一个虎头印记……是北狄的间谍没错。”
content_en: Your Majesty, the matter has been settled."Not far after the carriage drove away, Ning Chuan appeared next to the carriage. "Well, since the prince doesn't want him, then I will give him to the fourth child and lock him with the fourth child."In the carriage, the smile on Emperor Yan Wen's lips gradually faded. He originally wanted to leave Tang Yi to the prince, but this idiot failed to live up to his expectations. If this kid is not good enough to scheme, who in the world can conspire with you? "Your Majesty, the fourth prince has a fiery personality, and Tang Yi's arms and legs..." Chen Diaosi reminded him in a low voice, considering Tang Yi's current body, can he withstand a beating? "It's just to make them fight... However, the play really can't be too deliberate.Emperor Yanwen pondered for a moment and said, "Let's lock him up next door to the fourth child!"Ning Chuan, find a way to anger the fourth child and make him cause trouble for Tang Yi."Men, the best way to enhance your relationship is to have a fight!""Let them get used to it as soon as possible. I will leave the case of the Ministry of Household Affairs to them.""This is the reason why Jinyiwei is very unfriendly to Tang Yi. Because Emperor Yanwen has already told Ningchuan that Tang Yi will be admitted to Jinyiwei in a while and he will be given a hundred households. Countless brothers in Jinyiwei have been struggling for several years to get the position. He, a guy without any merit, will be a hundred households, and he will have real power. Who can bear this? "I obey the order."Ning Chuan handed over his hands and turned to leave. "Hmph, the Ministry of Household Taxes pay six to seven million yuan every year, but now the money that can be spent is less than five hundred thousand taels!"I want to see where all these silver coins have gone!""Emperor Yanwen looked ugly. He had just decided to fight Beidi! But the Ministry of Revenue suddenly thundered and told him that he had no money. Then it was revealed that Liu Gongjin had embezzled hundreds of thousands of taels of taxes. What a coincidence!" Chen Diao Temple sent someone to the Liang family to take Tang Yin to Concubine Xian.Emperor Yanwen's eyes grew colder: "At this time, I will never allow any more accidents.""Tang Yi cares most about Tang Yin. If something unexpected happens to Tang Yin, Tang Yi has to rebel!""... Beizhen Fusi, prison. As soon as Tang Yi entered the prison, an unpleasant smell of decay and blood hit his nostrils. At the same time, hysterical screams also came from the corridor, like howling ghosts. Ning Chuan followed Tang Yi with a few guards in royal robes. He felt that an official son like Tang Yi would definitely vomit and have diarrhea on the spot when he saw such a stench and screams, and he would be so scared that he would pee.Unexpectedly, Tang Yi looked calm.He seemed to be curious about the layout of the prison.He made comments from time to time, saying that the TV series was too conservative?And when he met some prisoners, this guy even smiled and chatted with them.Can't you just pretend to be afraid?I feel so embarrassed when you do this."Ning Chuan was a little angry and couldn't bear it anymore. Damn, isn't this guy the son of a civil servant? How can a son of a civil servant be so courageous? They say that Beizhen Fusi is the Palace of the King of Hell. How about you respect the Palace of the King of Hell? What they don't know is that Tang Yi has been on the battlefield. How can the smell and bloody scenes he smelled on the battlefield be compared to this little Jinyiwei prison? "This guy was not punished. What crime did he commit?"Tang Yi stopped in front of a cell and looked at the prisoners inside curiously. The man inside was about forty years old, wearing brocade clothes, and was quietly in the cell. Although his face was calm, his eyes were full of arrogance and contempt.Yi.That kind of look made them look like shit!They were arrogant and arrogant.After looking at him carefully from top to bottom, a look of determination flashed in his eyes."You came to jail for committing a crime. Do you think you are being inspected by the superior?""Ning Chuan raised his foot and kicked Tang Yi on the butt. But he still answered Tang Yi's question: "He is a merchant from Huizhou. There is some problem with the road, but it is not a big problem. Once his guarantor guarantees him, he can leave."Of course, the premise is that a large amount of bail must be paid, otherwise Jin Yiwei will lose his cards? "He can't let him go. On the contrary, you can arrange it and arrest his guarantor too."Ning Chuan and a group of guards in uniform looked at Tang Yi, and even the man inside looked up. Tang Yi grabbed the iron bars of the cell with both hands, looked at the middle-aged man and said, "You are a detective from Beidi, right?Look at you like this. You were caught by Jin Yiwei by accident just after you arrived in Kyoto."Hearing this, the middle-aged man's pupils suddenly shrank, but he quickly regained his composure. "What did you say?!"Ning Chuan jumped up in an instant, shocked by Tang Yi's words. A group of Jinyi guards also looked at Tang Yi dumbfounded. We arrested him and interrogated him, and got confirmation from the news that this guy was indeed a businessman from Huizhou. How could he be an agent of Beidi? With just one look, how could you be sure that he was an agent of Beidi? "Jinyiwei?Haha, I am worried about your ability to do your job.Tang Yi shook his head, pointed at the man's long hair and said, "First of all, it's this guy's bun. Although he messed up his hair when he was arrested, the messy long hair was curled, and traces of the braid can still be seen.""Men wear several or even hundreds of braids. This is a typical Beidi dress.""As for why he doesn't even use disguise, it's because he doesn't look down on you at all... Look at his eyes, which are arrogant, disdainful, and contemptuous. Does he look at shit when he looks at you?""A businessman dares to look at you like this?"Is it possible?"Besides, he is too calm and calm!"What kind of businessman should be able to enter the prison without changing his face???"In addition, pay attention to the bow legs, which means that this guy has been riding horses for a long time and his legs have been deformed.""If these speculations are not enough... then take off his clothes. This guy is a traitor among the Dayan people. As we all know, the Dayan people are treated as slaves by the Beidi people and they are divided into different levels.""There should be slave marks on his body.""The man listened to Tang Yi's words. He was disdainful at first, then gradually shocked, and finally looked at Tang Yi with resentment and fear. The Jin Yiwei was so fooled by him using money that he didn't pay attention to these details. Unexpectedly, the young man saw through it. The man turned around without saying a word.He hit the stone wall.He was about to commit suicide!However, as soon as he turned around, the knife in Ning Chuan's hand was already unsheathed, and it had pierced the man's thigh.At the same time, several Jinyi guards behind him also reacted quickly, cutting the chains with their swords, and rushed into the cell to kill the man.
title_en: Chapter 35 Kong Shilan, don’t regret it
